title: Medical Device Sales Representative
description:

Descrição:
Cargo Medical Device Sales Representative Indústria Número de vagas 1 Descrição da função About the job Company Description CONTEC USA represents Contec Medical Systems Co., Ltd., a high-tech medical device company founded in 1996 and headquartered in Qinhuangdao, China. CONTEC is one of the largest medical device R&D and manufacturing bases in China and became a publicly listed company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in August 2020 (Stock Code: 300869). With more than 1,000 employees and comprehensive R&D, production, and sales systems, CONTEC holds multiple international certifications, including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, and BSCI. The company offers over 20 product categories such as pulse oximeters, sphygmomanometers, ECG, EEG, ultrasound equipment, patient monitors, and imaging equipment, backed by more than 100 national patents and global regulatory approvals (CE, FDA, Canada, Japan, Brazil). CONTEC products are distributed in over 130 countries and regions, guided by a people-oriented, innovative, and win-win development philosophy focused on sustainable, global growth. Role Description The Angola Medical Device Sales Representative is a full-time remote role responsible for promoting and selling CONTEC medical devices to healthcare facilities and distributors across Angola. This role includes identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing existing accounts, and building long-term relationships with medical professionals and purchasing stakeholders. The representative will conduct product presentations and demonstrations, support evaluations in clinical settings, and provide guidance on product features, benefits, and proper use. Daily activities include coordinating with internal teams on pricing and logistics, monitoring market trends and competitor activity, and preparing regular sales forecasts and reports. The role also involves ensuring compliance with local regulations and company policies while maintaining high ethical standards in all sales activities. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Medical Sales and Sales skills, with experience achieving or exceeding sales targets in healthcare or related industries. Candidates should possess knowledge of Orthopedics and Operating Room environments to effectively communicate with surgeons, clinicians, and OR staff. Candidates should possess a solid understanding of Medicine and medical terminology to accurately present device features and clinical benefits. Relevant experience in medical device sales within Angola or similar markets, including established relationships with hospitals, clinics, and distributors. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote setting. Proficiency in English and Portuguese is highly beneficial; additional local languages are an advantage. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Willingness to travel within Angola for client meetings, product demonstrations, and industry events, as required. Your role: Develop new business, conduct client visits and product demonstrations, manage sales opportunities, and grow CONTEC’s presence in Angola.

Título: Medical Device Sales Representative

Empresa: Contec Medical Systems

Localização: Luanda, Luanda

Tipo de contrato: Contrato de serviços

Sobre a empresa

A CONTEC USA representa a Contec Medical Systems Co., Ltd., empresa de alta tecnologia em dispositivos médicos fundada em 1996, com sede em Qinhuangdao, China. É uma das maiores bases de P&D e fabricação de dispositivos médicos na China e tornou‑se empresa listada na Bolsa de Shenzhen em agosto de 2020 (Código: 300869). Conta com mais de 1 000 colaboradores e possui sistemas integrados de pesquisa, produção e vendas. A CONTEC detém certificações internacionais ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 14001 e BSCI, oferece mais de 20 categorias de produtos (oxímetros de pulso, esfigmomanômetros, ECG, EEG, equipamentos de ultrassom, monitores de pacientes, equipamentos de imagem, entre outros) e possui mais de 100 patentes nacionais, além de aprovações regulatórias globais (CE, FDA, Canadá, Japão, Brasil). Seus produtos são distribuídos em mais de 130 países e regiões, guiados por uma filosofia de desenvolvimento centrada nas pessoas, inovadora e de benefício mútuo, focada no crescimento sustentável e global.

Descrição do cargo

O representante de vendas de dispositivos médicos para Angola atua em regime remoto, em tempo integral, sendo responsável por promover e vender os produtos CONTEC a hospitais, clínicas e distribuidores em todo o território angolano.

  • Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Gerir contas existentes e cultivar relacionamentos de longo prazo com profissionais de saúde e responsáveis de compras.
  • Realizar apresentações e demonstrações de produtos, apoiando avaliações em ambientes clínicos.
  • Orientar clientes sobre funcionalidades, benefícios e uso correto dos dispositivos.
  • Coordenar com as equipas internas questões de preços, logística e suporte técnico.
  • Monitorizar tendências de mercado e a atividade da concorrência.
  • Elaborar previsões de vendas e relatórios periódicos.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas locais e das políticas da empresa, mantendo elevados padrões éticos nas atividades de venda.

Qualificações

  • Fortes competências em vendas médicas, com histórico de cumprimento ou superação de metas no setor de saúde ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em ortopedia e ambientes de salas de cirurgia, permitindo comunicação eficaz com cirurgiões
requisitos: strong medical sales skills, experience meeting sales targets, knowledge of orthopedics and operating room environments, understanding of medical terminology, experience in medical device sales in Angola, established relationships with hospitals and distributors, strong communication and negotiation skills, ability to work independently remote, proficiency in English and Portuguese, bachelor's degree in business or related field
